_comment: Template for a project .mcp.json. Google's own Drive MCP server CANNOT be added this way: it rejects Claude Code's auth with 'does not support dynamic client registration' and must be added as a custom connector on claude.ai. This template is for a read-only Drive MCP server that does support it. Add the matching deny rules from claude-settings-readonly.json, and verify them with scripts/check_deny_rules.py before connecting.
